decisions.reason: The source identifies the supplied video as a temporary placeholder, but the preceding context does not resolve whether that asset designation applies to the Gallery video as well as the Homepage video; applying it to the Gallery would require clarification.
The temporary role of the Homepage video asset does not change where Homepage portfolio tiles navigate.
The video asset's temporary placeholder status does not alter portfolio hover-animation behavior.
The source concerns a video asset and does not change the sourcing, selection, or replacement rules for site images.
The temporary portfolio video does not change the Homepage hero image, overlay, or image-emphasis requirements.
The designation of a video as a temporary placeholder does not affect Homepage button destinations or navigation behavior.
The source specifies the role of a video asset and does not modify the Gallery's portfolio photograph source or target photo count.
The placeholder reference concerns a video and is unrelated to the mobile pricing table's horizontal-scrolling behavior.
Identifying the Homepage video as temporary does not change the Gallery's category tabs or its optional other-photography area.
